title: He-2025-vocalmind-10.1038/s41597-025-04741-2
description: VocalMind is a stereotactic EEG (sEEG) dataset for speech decoding research in a tonal language (Mandarin Chinese). Intracranial recordings were acquired while a participant produced vocalized, mimed, and imagined speech. The dataset supports research on speech brain-computer interfaces and neural decoding of overt and covert speech. This BIDS release includes one subject.
methods_description: Intracranial sEEG recordings were sampled at 1000 Hz during vocalized, mimed, and imagined speech tasks. Per-trial CSV files were concatenated per speech mode and converted to BIDS iEEG (BrainVision) format, with events.tsv marking each stimulus onset.
